name: Espand
indication_description:
Espand is indicated in-
  • Spermatorrhoea
  • Premature ejaculation
  • Excessive Nocturnal emission
  • Nervous debility
  • Sexual debility
  • General debility
  • Gonorrhoea
pharmacology_description: This is a unique unani medicine prepared with the various natural active ingredients, which is highly effective in the treatment of spermatorrhoea, premature ejaculation and excessive nocturnal emission. It combats sexual debility and nervous debility.
dosage_description: 2 tablets twice daily or as prescribed by the physicians.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
